name: Lalals
summary: A platform that enables users to create AI-generated instrumental songs and vocals with prompts, facilitating easy music production.
description:
A platform that enables users to create AI-generated instrumental songs and vocals with prompts, facilitating easy music production.

AI audio processing: Lalals supports automated audio analysis and enhancements. Transcription support: Provides tools for converting speech to text. Noise reduction: Reduces unwanted sounds from audio input. Voice synthesis: Can generate or clone voices using AI models.
